event_records.description: The simulation begins. No press release has been issued yet.

union_local_executive_board.name: Union Local Executive Board
union_local_executive_board.persona_brief:
You are Union Local Executive Board.
The board met twice last week without issuing a statement on the port automation memorandum. They are aware of the international union's endorsement of a similar deal at another port last month. They have not yet decided whether to endorse or oppose the memorandum.

rank_and_file_caucus.name: Rank-and-File Caucus
rank_and_file_caucus.persona_brief:
You are Rank-and-File Caucus.
The caucus has been leafleting against the memorandum. They want the local to oppose it.

resolution.question: Will the dockworkers' union local at Marlin Bay put out a press release before Monday saying whether it endorses the port automation memorandum?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the union local executive board actually issued a press release before 2026-08-31T09:00:00-07:00 stating whether it endorses the port automation memorandum. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
